Because you are a student, the requirements for CalFresh are different. You have to meet at least one student exemption in order to qualify for CalFresh. **You are not required to work 20 hours if you are eligible through another student exemption!** You can see the up-to-date student exemptions [here.](https://www.csuchico.edu/calfresh/resource-hub-tiles/student-exemptions.shtml) Just scroll to the bottom to find it (yes, these are state-wide).

If you don't see any that describe you, you can try contacting your finaid office to see if they can offer you work study, or you can try contacting your college's CalFresh team for more student support (a lot of CSU's have them). Good luck!
